question: Do deterministic runtime checks (System 0) let the deployed Qwen3.5-4B close its round-2 gap to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on the adjudicated suite, at 4B latency?
motivation: Oracle routing 4B<->35B from the paired receipt: 131/180, only +10 over always-35B; learned and task routers already failed (PR #83, PR #96).
The 35B's wins concentrate in stale premises, conflict rules, distractors, injected tool output and execute refusals: checks that software can perform.
PR #96 relay test: passing another model's unverified reasoning made the 35B worse (0.528 -> 0.389); System 0 passes only checked facts.

arms.4b-s0: same loop; checks.py findings appended to model-visible user/tool messages; trace and scoring unchanged

settings.engine: llama.cpp b11146 (built from the release tag, CUDA)
settings.hardware: Slink is offline (RAM fault). Planned: Kaggle notebook, 2x T4; 4B pinned to one GPU. Any host is acceptable if all compared arms run on it in one session.

replication.note: same generator templates over new worlds; tests world overfitting, not template overfitting

decision_rules.H1_primary: On the 180 frozen episodes, 4b-s0 vs 4b-plain on the same host: gained > lost and two-sided sign test p < 0.05.
decision_rules.H2_hare_thesis: 4b-s0 >= (35B score - 10). The 35B score is 35b-plain from the same session if run, otherwise the round-2 receipt (121, so the bar is 111). The 4b-s0 mean seconds per episode must be below the 35B's when both ran on one host; otherwise the latency claim is marked unmeasured.
decision_rules.replication: On the 179 fresh episodes, 4b-s0 gained > lost (p reported, not gated).
decision_rules.harm_guard: No family may show a paired net loss of 3 or more episodes (of 12) for s0 vs plain. Any such family blocks adoption and is reported.
decision_rules.calibration: 4b-plain on the new host is compared with round-2's 58/180. |difference| > 10 is reported as environment drift; paired arms remain valid.
decision_rules.adoption: System 0 is proposed for Purple Copilot/Haven only if H1, the harm guard and replication direction all hold. H2 decides whether the 4B can replace the 35B for this class of work.
decision_rules.kill: If H1 fails, System 0 annotations are not adopted, 35B thinking-off remains the hard-case default, and the d1-2B escalation experiment is not started.

next_if_pass: Separate preregistration: replace classify_request with Liquid d1-2B and test it as an escalation signal against saved per-episode outcomes.
disclosures: Checks were written after reading the generator's family list (suite-aware). They read only the request text and tool outputs, never expectations or world state; tests enforce no new facts and an untouched scored trace.
The request classifier is a regex placeholder for a decision model.
One greedy run per arm. Different GPU kernels can change greedy outputs, so only same-host arms are compared directly.
External validity requires the independent Purple Copilot held-out set (PR #113 Phase 4), not this suite.
